memory_bridge: Send an echo around the enclosure three ways: 今回 counts “this time” with On カイ; the echo itself circles back with 回る, Kun まわる; and a hand turns the enclosure with 回す, Kun まわす. The circular image distinguishes self-turning from actively turning something.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 今回（こんかい）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Stamp 今回（こんかい）, “this time,” each time the echo completes a circuit; the final character uses On カイ.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 回る（まわる）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Watch the echo travel around the enclosure by itself and 回る（まわる）; the complete intransitive verb fixes Kun まわる, “to turn.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 回す（まわす）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Reach in with a hand and actively spin the inner mouth, 回す（まわす）; the complete transitive verb fixes Kun まわす, “to turn.”
